humanTitle: People are refused money back after a stay goes wrong
whoItAffects: iPhone travellers in the United States and Canada, across four app versions.

build.proposition: A record of what both sides agreed, that neither can quietly edit.
specifics: Capture an agreed amount and date as a signed item in the thread
Show the agreement's state when either party opens the dispute
Start with the agreed-then-reversed path reviewers describe
build.limitation: The platform mediates the dispute and also writes the software, so it has no reason to bind itself.

start.proposition: Evidence handling for people disputing an accommodation charge.
specifics: Collects photographs, timestamps and messages into one submitted file
Charged per dispute rather than per subscription
start.limitation: The people who need it most have already lost money and are unwilling to spend more.

study.proposition: What happens after a host agrees to a refund and then disputes it?
specifics: Test whether a written agreement changes the eventual result
study.limitation: Outcomes are settled privately, so the sample is only people who chose to post about it.

write.proposition: The refund agreed in writing, then reversed.
specifics: Follow one traveller from the agreement to the reversal
Quote the reviews where a representative calculated the amount
write.limitation: Platform-dispute stories are familiar; the specific turn is the written agreement being undone.
